Title: Establishes the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) program; repealer
Summary: Establishes the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) program to provide financial assistance and reimbursement to municipalities for the abatement, removal and replacement of lead-contaminated water supply lines; establishes the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) fund; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.
LawCode: Rpld & add §1114, Pub Health L; add §98-e, St Fin L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) program; to amend the state finance law, in relation to establishing the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) fund; and to repeal certain provisions of the public health law relating thereto
